requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains syntactic and referential ambiguities. Both are resolved using business rule BR-01 which mandates independent specification of partner registration and reporting subscription. The requirement is decomposed into two distinct functional requirements: one for adding System-B to System-A's downstream systems, and one for allowing System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.

source_fragments: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must add System-B to its downstream systems.
structuring_notes: Resolved referential ambiguity ('their' -> System-A) and syntactic ambiguity (independent action) per BR-01.

source_fragments: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

fields.object: System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
structuring_notes: Extracted as a second independent functional requirement per BR-01.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Interpretation B (sequential/dependent relationship between adding System-B and allowing System-C)
Interpretation B ('their' refers to a collective entity of System-A and System-B)
